# PROCESS — what I did this iteration (explainability; REQUIRED) — cand_0002

Diagnosed all 24 failing traces this iteration with 4 parallel read-only subagents (general-purpose),
one per group of 6. Separated ENVIRONMENT + broken-ground-truth from prompt-fixable, then applied
MULTIPLE different lever types (narrowing rule, missing-knowledge, output-contract, worked-condition,
recovery guidance, structural checklist). Priority was recovering the two REGRESSIONS the current
champion (cand_0001) introduced (55609, 59259), since those were passing before and are the surest gain.

## Ranked issue list (leverage = #tasks × recoverable score, biggest first)
| rank | cluster | tasks | shared root cause | tag |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Over-applied anti-hardcode → fragile content-search (REGRESSIONS) | 55609, 59259 | cand_0001's "detect extent dynamically" rule was over-generalized: agent re-discovered a FIXED block location by scanning cell contents. On hidden inputs the pattern isn't found → `raise` → no output (55609), or a mis-refactored aggregation (59259). Both were PASSING before cand_0001. | KNOWLEDGE / narrowing |
| 2 | Code raises before saving → 0 | 55609 | Search for a header/row returns None on hidden inputs and code `raise`s → output_path never written → 0 on those inputs. | recovery guidance |
| 3 | Sentinel ban too broad; honor instruction literals/errors | 59259 ("may be '-'"), 57232 ("may be #N/A") | cand_0001's blanket ban on writing `"-"`/`"#N/A"` collided with instructions that explicitly say the answer MAY be that literal. | KNOWLEDGE / narrowing |
| 4 | Fill all answer cells / don't invent transforms | 39046, 56637 | Agent invented a dedup/first-occurrence rule (39046, left 2/5 cells blank) or invented labels/scheduling (56637) instead of writing the requested value into every cell. | output-contract |
| 5 | Value/type + normalization | 50630 (`\xa0`), 325-44 (code-string→int) | Stray non-breaking space copied verbatim; zero-padded code strings coerced to int (type + value drift). Exact value+type compare fails. | KNOWLEDGE / type |
| 6 | Reuse existing formula logic | 11842 | Answer cells already held correct formulas; agent discarded them and recomputed from raw daily marks → mostly zeros. | KNOWLEDGE |
| 7 | Stale cached formula values in INPUT | 38332 (spilled UNIQUE), 51359? | `data_only` cache absent/stale on hidden inputs → miscount. | KNOWLEDGE |
| 8 | Mandatory final-turn verification | 325-44 | Agent dropped the verification print in its final turn (ended on a bare write) → never caught mismatch. | STRUCTURE |
| 9 | Interpretation: directional / filter semantics | 55931 (sign of "from X to Y"), 110-2 (filter=visibility) | Flipped difference sign; collapsed filtered rows destroying data. | KNOWLEDGE |

## Changes made this iteration (all in prompt.md unless noted)
| # | cluster | lever | file / section | what & why it generalizes | blast radius |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | 1,6 | narrowing rule + missing-knowledge | prompt.md "THREE input files" (new paras) | "What VARIES vs FIXED": data values + row COUNT vary; layout/columns/header-rows/named ranges are FIXED — use named anchors directly, don't re-discover positions by content search. Plus "existing formulas define the intended computation — read/extend, don't reinvent". | BOUNDED — narrows cand_0001's extent rule; passing tasks use `max_row` extent detection (unchanged) and don't content-search fixed anchors. |
| 2 | 3 | narrowing rule + error-value carve-out | prompt.md "Write final VALUES" (data_only line + new Exception) | data_only cache may be stale on hidden inputs → compute from raw source. Narrow exception: when the expected answer can be an Excel ERROR (#N/A…), write a recalc-able live formula so the error TYPE matches (a Python `"#N/A"` string can't). | BOUNDED — exception fires only when instruction says answer may be an error; no passing "fix-my-formula" task (47741) expects an error, so its literal-value behavior is unchanged. |
| 3 | 3,5 | contract narrowing + type knowledge | prompt.md "Match value AND type" | Sentinel ban applies only to sentinels the agent INVENTS; honor instruction-prescribed literals (`-`, blank, token). Keep code-like/zero-padded strings as text. Strip `\xa0`/whitespace from string outputs. | BOUNDED — additive; passing tasks have no `\xa0`, no code-coercion, no prescribed-sentinel need. |
| 4 | 4,9 | output-contract + interpretation | prompt.md "Touch only the answer cells" | Fill every cell the instruction gives a value for (no invented dedup/filter blanks); do exactly the op asked (no invented labels/counts/scheduling); filter/hide = visibility not deletion; "difference from X to Y" = Y−X. | BOUNDED — kept "leave blank when data genuinely yields none"; filter rule carved out "unless asked to delete/extract". |
| 5 | 2 | recovery guidance | prompt.md "Finish cleanly" | Final code must ALWAYS write output_path; guard searches with a fallback to task-named positions instead of `raise`-ing. | BOUNDED — passing tasks that use `raise` (52021,51958,58109) succeed (their raise never fires); advice conditioned on "search that can fail". |
| 6 | 8 | structural gate | task_template.md step 3 | "Done" is now a precondition: most recent turn must be a verification turn printing value+type of every answer cell; never end on a bare write. | BOUNDED — verification is a read-only check; correct outputs unchanged. |

## Verify-the-fix (one line per change; evidence from traces)
- 55609: code `raise ValueError("No matching source header row…")` on inputs 2&3 → feedback "produced NO output file". Edit 1 says use the named block D-range directly (don't content-search); Edit 5 says fall back + always save. Had either been present, output would have been written from the fixed anchor → matches (layout fixed). Recovers a regression cand_0001 caused.
- 59259: final rewrite added a same-calendar-year constraint (dynamic-header refactor) AND wrote `0`/never `"-"` though instruction says "output may be '-'". Edit 1 (don't over-refactor fixed layout) + Edit 3 (honor prescribed `"-"`) target both. 2/3 already pass; recovers the third.
- 57232: wrote string `"#N/A"` for lookup misses → can't match error-typed cell; manual lookup also buggy. Edit 2 exception → live INDEX/MATCH recalcs to real value + #N/A type.
- 39046: wrote `[2,2,0,None,None]` (invented first-occurrence dedup) leaving F5/F6 blank = untouched input. Edit 4 "fill every cell, don't invent dedup" → all 5 filled.
- 56637: wrote `"1st Shift"`/`"2nd Shift"` labels where numbers expected. Edit 4 "'populate <value>' means write that value, don't invent labels/scheduling".
- 50630: output kept trailing `'\xa0'` (`'rafal kucharski\xa0'`). Edit 3 strip-whitespace → exact match.
- 325-44: `coerce_value` turned `"03"`→3; also dropped verification in final turn. Edit 3 (keep code-strings as text) + Edit 6 (mandatory verify).
- 11842: discarded working answer-cell formulas summing AG:AN, recomputed raw → zeros. Edit 1 "existing formulas define the computation — read/extend".
- 38332: read spilled-UNIQUE col C via stale `data_only` cache → miscount on input 3. Edit 2 "compute from raw source, cache may be stale".
- 55931: computed `previous − current`; "change from X to Y" = Y−X. Edit 4 directional rule.
- 110-2: collapsed A1:C13 to matching rows, blanked the rest (AutoFilter). Edit 4 "filter = visibility, keep every row".

## Blast-radius summary (SAFE test)
Every edit is ADDITIVE or a NARROWING of an existing rule; none loosens a global decision/permission.
Passing tasks protected: all 26 (94-8,160-6,185-13,353-29,435-38,448-11,458-49,575-16,587-38,CF_11072,
41297,48354,52021,53167,1563,16511,44266,46897,51958,55060,55667,58047,58147,47741,56975,58109). They
already compute dynamically, write correct types, and fill only valued cells, so reinforcing/narrowing
those rules changes no output. The one edit with a residual (small) risk is the filter=visibility line
(110-2 class) — carved out with "unless asked to delete/extract rows" to spare any passing extract task.

## Deliberately skipped (ENVIRONMENT / broken or non-derivable ground truth — a prompt edit cannot recover)
- 73-45: ENVIRONMENT — grader feedback states formula recalculation FAILED (stale cached compare). Handed back; not a prompt defect.
- 56996: expected values are cached RANDBETWEEN draws; recalc re-rolls → non-deterministic, unwinnable.
- 59667, 59743: ground-truth "Desired Results" directly CONTRADICTS the stated instruction (confirmed in traces) — the faithful answer is rejected. Chasing these would push the agent to guess and would hurt genuinely-fixable cases.
- 5192: the two worked examples are mutually contradictory under any single rule — unwinnable.
- 450-9, 30709, 3911: matched the visible demo/2-of-3 already; residual failures are unobservable ground-truth quirks / date-order ambiguity / a blank-count preview edge — low leverage, not confidently prompt-fixable.

## Process & features used
- 4 parallel general-purpose subagents diagnosed the 24 failing traces (read-only), each returning per-task root cause + classification + recommended general lever. I cross-checked the two regressions myself and audited how the 26 passing tasks use `max_row`/`raise` to bound blast radius.
- Prior iterations: built on cand_0001 (ACCEPTED, val 0.520). Did NOT re-try anything cand_0001's RESULT showed regressing beyond fixing its two casualties; specifically I NARROWED, not reverted, its anti-hardcode and sentinel rules so its fixed tasks (353-29,47741,51958,CF_11072) stay fixed.
